w: The small murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored in the presence of Swamishri and thousands of devotees.

The five day 80th Birthday Celebration of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and Mandir Murti Pratishtha Mahotsav festival commenced. Swamishri initiated 21 parshads into the Bhagvat diksha (saffron) and 2 youths into parshad diksha. Pujya Mahant Swami inaugurated a new audio cassette of bhajans on Swamishri - 'Pyaru Pramukh Swami Keru Naam' and a set of ten audio cassette discourses by Swamishri.
In the evening the Municipal Corporation of Anand town honored Swamishri and talked glowingly of Swamishri's socio-spiritual works.
ph: 80th Birthday Celebration of Pramukh swami Maharaj

w: At 10.20 a.m. Swamishri went for darshan of the mandirs in Dakor, Swamishri also sanctified a sanctuary for cows called 'Shri Dakor Khodadhor Panjrapol Trust' run by BAPS. At present 321 cows are being looked after.
BAPS Tribal Uplift Activities in Sabarkantha District :

From 1982, through the inspiration and efforts of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and sadhus, the BAPS has been performing noteworthy services for the uplift of tribal people in the regions Khedbrahma and Poshina. The services are as follows:
Health services : BAPS Medical vans tours the interior tribal regions and treat 300 patients free of cost per day.

Anti-Addiction : as part of its ongoing de-addiction programs a recently held camp was attended by tribals from 70 villages. Beside giving up addictions they also pledged to become vegetarians by not killing and eating goats and buffaloes.
Watershed Projects : BAPS is performing water conservation and harvesting projects in 12 villages.
Education : Literacy drive, scholarships and distribution of notebooks. Mobile education project through a van that will teach tribal children in interior areas is under planning.

Tribal Women's Uplift : To make them self-supporting they are provided with means to help them grow vegetables and earn a living. Special programs for education and anti-addiction are also held for women.
Relief Works : In times of famine the BAPS has organized cattle camps, fodder distribution, food distribution, etc.
Character Building : Through weekly satsang assemblies, and personal contact the tribals are inspired with moral and spiritual values and pride for Hinduism.
Superstitions and Bad Customs : To abolish superstitions and vices personal contact by volunteers inspires faith in God.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

On 30 November 2004, in Bochasan, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was starting his breakfast. Looking towards the sadhus, he asked them to read from a scripture.

A sadhu said candidly, "Swami! You remain engaged in so many activities: there are meetings, phone calls, private matters. Despite all this, how do you immediately feel like reading? We do only a little, and yet we get absorbed in activity and feel less like reading."

Hearing this, Swamishri said, "Basically, when the intoxication of activity takes hold, one does not feel like it. We are to do all the activities, but we are not to become one with the activity. This is what has to be done. Gunatitanand Swami has written, 'He went to the cowshed and then could not come back to the dharmashala.' What was the reason? He became one with the action. Spiritual discourse is our life, but we do not even think in that direction. However much activity we do, if we become one with it we fall back. But attachment to spiritual discourse must be kept constantly."

ds.t: Let us meet a few devotees first
w: This morning was as ordinary as any other. The cold too was as on any other day. As every day, Pramukh Swami Maharaj had darshan everywhere, came to the assembly hall and sat for his puja, but after a while Swamishri gestured and called the attendant sadhu and said, "I feel cold." A shawl was put on Swamishri. However, there was some weakness within the body, so the attendant sadhu wrapped the shawl so that air would not get in from any corner. Swamishri had suddenly felt a chill. However, there was no change in the order or timing of the puja. The sadhus only noted that during the puja the hand holding the mala seemed to be jerking somewhat.

After the puja Swamishri came to his residence. Dr Nikul measured Swamishri's pulse. The pulse was faster than usual. It was beating at around 100 to 120, and was also irregular. Because of this it was decided to take an ECG immediately. Yogicharan Swami spoke of taking the ECG and went into the bedroom to prepare. Swamishri too was going that way, but suddenly Swamishri said in a somewhat loud voice, "Yogi! Let us meet a few devotees, then we will do all this."

Now, today was the last day; today he was to go to Anand. On the last day there are no meetings, yet Swamishri wished to meet the devotees who had come about the land in Lathi. So a short meeting had been arranged.
Yogicharan Swami said, "It would be better to take the ECG first and then meet the devotees."
Swamishri said, "Meeting them will take only five minutes. If we meet them first..."
But in the present state of his health, the ECG coming first was what mattered.

Even in this situation one could see how eager Swamishri is, without caring about his own illness, for the work of the organisation and for the devotees! Really, compared to his health, no meeting was that important at the moment, yet this can only be called Swamishri's pure compassion.

Dr Harshadbhai Joshi, who had come from Surat, came to examine Pramukh Swami Maharaj. For the last few days, while walking, after one or two rounds Swamishri had been getting pain in the thigh and, after a while, in the waist too. In this connection he examined Swamishri's legs in particular and made a diagnosis.
Finally the doctor said, "Give all such illnesses to us doctors. We will diagnose them ourselves and take the pills."
Swamishri said, "Why do such a thing?"
Dr Harshadbhai Joshi said, "Why should you have to suffer? Everything is in your hands, isn't it!"
Swamishri said, "It is because it is in our hands that we suffer."
It was as if Swamishri were saying that because everything is in his hands, he takes everyone's suffering and endures it. He takes on everyone's suffering.
When his meal was over, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Come, if you have your letters, let us write two or four; there is still time."
Dharmacharan Swami said, "Rest today; you are not well, so we'll see tomorrow."

How regular and dedicated to work Swamishri is even at this age!! In seva Swamishri is ever youthful! There is not a trace of laziness in him. He cannot bear work to stop under any excuse. Young and old alike should learn this dedication to work.
